leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize and manage a state variable to store an array of todo items.
Construct a form with an input field and a button to capture new todo text.
Implement a handler function to add a new todo item to the state array.
Render a dynamic list of todo items using the map method.
Configure a delete button for each todo item to remove it from the state.
Apply conditional rendering to display a message when no todos exist.
Manipulate the state to update the todo list based on user interactions.
